PROTOTYPE JOURNEY 00

Consent in the OPD waiting room.

Most patients meet consent on a busy outpatient morning — standing in a crowded queue, maybe reading slowly, maybe not in English. So we design for that first, not last.

A front-desk staffer drives the screen on a shared kiosk. The patient watches, listens, and chooses.
Plain words, big buttons, the patient's own language, and a read-aloud option — not legal walls of text.
If the patient says no to something required, care isn't silently blocked — the refusal is captured and routed to a clinician.

ABHA = Ayushman Bharat Health Account, India's national health ID. Consent purpose = the specific reason data is used (e.g. treatment vs. research). Under the DPDP Act, each purpose needs its own clear yes.

PROTOTYPE JOURNEY 00

Withdrawal that actually executes.

Withdrawing consent shouldn't just flip a flag in one app. The patient taps "withdraw" once — and the system fans that out into real, routed, tracked tasks across every place the data lives, then proves each one was carried out.

DPDP Act 2023 · S6(4)–(6): withdraw as easily as you gave; downstream must act

                  <button type="button" class="swfstudio-editbtn"><svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4z"/></svg> Edit → new version</button>

                  <div class="swfstudio-wfcompl"><div class="swfstudio-bar"><div class="swfstudio-barfill" style="width:88%"></div></div><span class="swfstudio-compllbl">88% completion</span></div>
                  <button type="button" class="swfstudio-editbtn"><svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4z"/></svg> Edit → new version</button>

                  <button type="button" class="swfstudio-editbtn"><svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4z"/></svg> Edit → new version</button>

                  <button type="button" class="swfstudio-editbtn"><svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4z"/></svg> Edit → new version</button>

          <!-- FOOTER NAV -->
          <div class="swfstudio-foot">
            <button type="button" class="swfstudio-navbtn" id="swfstudio-back" disabled>
              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M15 18l-6-6 6-6"/></svg> Back
            </button>
            <div class="swfstudio-dots" id="swfstudio-dots" role="group" aria-label="Go to step">
              <button type="button" class="swfstudio-stepdot" data-go="1" aria-current="true" aria-label="Step 1"></button>
              <button type="button" class="swfstudio-stepdot" data-go="2" aria-current="false" aria-label="Step 2"></button>
              <button type="button" class="swfstudio-stepdot" data-go="3" aria-current="false" aria-label="Step 3"></button>
              <button type="button" class="swfstudio-stepdot" data-go="4" aria-current="false" aria-label="Step 4"></button>
              <button type="button" class="swfstudio-stepdot" data-go="5" aria-current="false" aria-label="Step 5"></button>
            </div>
            <span class="swfstudio-stepind" id="swfstudio-stepind">Step 1 of 5</span>
            <button type="button" class="swfstudio-restart" id="swfstudio-restart">
              <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 3-6.7L3 8"/><path d="M3 3v5h5"/></svg> Restart
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="swfstudio-navbtn swfstudio-navbtn--primary" id="swfstudio-next">
              Next <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 18l6-6-6-6"/></svg>

  <script>
  (function(){
    var root = document.getElementById('swfstudio');
    if(!root) return;

    var TOTAL = 5;
    var current = 1;
    var published = false;

    var screens = root.querySelectorAll('.swfstudio-screen');
    var publishedView = root.querySelector('#swfstudio-published');
    var railSteps = root.querySelectorAll('.swfstudio-step');
    var dots = root.querySelectorAll('.swfstudio-stepdot');
    var backBtn = root.querySelector('#swfstudio-back');
    var nextBtn = root.querySelector('#swfstudio-next');
    var stepInd = root.querySelector('#swfstudio-stepind');
    var restartBtn = root.querySelector('#swfstudio-restart');
    var publishBtn = root.querySelector('#swfstudio-publishbtn');

    // ---------- Approvers model ----------
    var ICONS = {
      physician:'<path d="M8 2v4a4 4 0 0 0 8 0V2"/><path d="M6 6v3a6 6 0 0 0 12 0V6"/><path d="M12 15v3a4 4 0 0 0 4 4h0a4 4 0 0 0 4-4v-1"/><circle cx="20" cy="11" r="1.5"/>',
      shield:'<path d="M12 2l8 4v6c0 5-3.5 8-8 10-4.5-2-8-5-8-10V6l8-4z"/>',
      patient:'<circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M4 21a8 8 0 0 1 16 0"/>',
      lab:'<path d="M9 2v6l-5 9a2 2 0 0 0 2 3h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-3l-5-9V2"/>',
      bill:'<rect x="5" y="3" width="14" height="18" rx="2"/><path d="M9 8h6M9 12h6M9 16h4"/>',
      records:'<path d="M4 4h12l4 4v12H4z"/><path d="M16 4v4h4"/>'
    };
    function approverIcon(key){
      return '<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">'+(ICONS[key]||ICONS.patient)+'</svg>';
    }
    var approvers = [
      { name:'Physician', sub:'Treating doctor confirms the request is clinically valid', icon:'physician' },
      { name:'DPO / Ethics', sub:'Data Protection Officer checks the privacy basis', icon:'shield' },
      { name:'Patient', sub:'Final consent — the patient must approve', icon:'patient', fixed:true }
    ];
    var ADDABLE = {
      'Lab Head':{ name:'Lab Head', sub:'Signs off when lab reports are in scope', icon:'lab' },
      'Billing':{ name:'Billing', sub:'Approves release of itemised bills', icon:'bill' },
      'Medical Records':{ name:'Medical Records', sub:'Department that holds the source records', icon:'records' }
    };
    var approverMode = 'sequential';

    var approversEl = root.querySelector('#swfstudio-approvers');
    var slaListEl = root.querySelector('#swfstudio-slalist');

    function renderApprovers(){
      if(!approversEl) return;
      approversEl.setAttribute('data-mode', approverMode);
      approversEl.innerHTML = '';
      approvers.forEach(function(a, i){
        var li = document.createElement('li');
        li.className = 'swfstudio-appchip';
        var canUp = i > 0;
        var canDown = i < approvers.length - 1;
        li.innerHTML =
          '<span class="swfstudio-grip" aria-hidden="true"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><circle cx="8" cy="6" r="1.4"/><circle cx="8" cy="12" r="1.4"/><circle cx="8" cy="18" r="1.4"/><circle cx="16" cy="6" r="1.4"/><circle cx="16" cy="12" r="1.4"/><circle cx="16" cy="18" r="1.4"/></svg></span>'+
          '<span class="swfstudio-appseq">'+(i+1)+'</span>'+
          '<span class="swfstudio-appbody"><h5>'+a.name+(a.fixed?' <span class="swfstudio-wfver" style="font-size:.56rem">required</span>':'')+'</h5><p>'+a.sub+'</p></span>'+
          '<span class="swfstudio-appacts">'+
            '<button type="button" class="swfstudio-iconbtn swfstudio-up" aria-label="Move up"'+(canUp?'':' disabled')+'><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 15l-6-6-6 6"/></svg></button>'+
            '<button type="button" class="swfstudio-iconbtn swfstudio-down" aria-label="Move down"'+(canDown?'':' disabled')+'><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>'+
            (a.fixed?'':'<button type="button" class="swfstudio-iconbtn swfstudio-iconbtn--del swfstudio-del" aria-label="Remove '+a.name+'"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M5 7h14M9 7V5h6v2M8 7l1 13h6l1-13"/></svg></button>')+
          '</span>';
        // wire icon-ico color via class swap (use brand)
        li.querySelector('.swfstudio-appseq').insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin','');
        (function(idx, node){
          var up = node.querySelector('.swfstudio-up');
          var down = node.querySelector('.swfstudio-down');
          var del = node.querySelector('.swfstudio-del');
          if(up) up.addEventListener('click', function(){ if(idx>0){ swap(idx, idx-1); } });
          if(down) down.addEventListener('click', function(){ if(idx<approvers.length-1){ swap(idx, idx+1); } });
          if(del) del.addEventListener('click', function(){ approvers.splice(idx,1); renderApprovers(); renderSLA(); });
        })(i, li);
        approversEl.appendChild(li);
      });
      refreshAddButtons();
    }
    function swap(a,b){
      var tmp = approvers[a]; approvers[a] = approvers[b]; approvers[b] = tmp;
      renderApprovers(); renderSLA();
    }
    function refreshAddButtons(){
      root.querySelectorAll('.swfstudio-addbtn').forEach(function(btn){
        var key = btn.getAttribute('data-add');
        var exists = approvers.some(function(a){ return a.name === ADDABLE[key].name; });
        btn.disabled = exists;
        btn.style.opacity = exists ? '.4' : '1';
      });
    }
    root.querySelectorAll('.swfstudio-addbtn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
        var key = btn.getAttribute('data-add');
        if(!ADDABLE[key]) return;
        if(approvers.some(function(a){ return a.name === ADDABLE[key].name; })) return;
        // insert before the fixed Patient step
        var insertAt = approvers.length;
        for(var i=0;i<approvers.length;i++){ if(approvers[i].fixed){ insertAt = i; break; } }
        approvers.splice(insertAt, 0, Object.assign({}, ADDABLE[key]));
        renderApprovers(); renderSLA();
      });
    });
    root.querySelectorAll('.swfstudio-modebtn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
        approverMode = btn.getAttribute('data-mode');
        root.querySelectorAll('.swfstudio-modebtn').forEach(function(b){ b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false'); });
        btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');
        renderApprovers();
      });
    });

    // ---------- SLA per step ----------
    var slaDefaults = { 'Physician':24, 'DPO / Ethics':12, 'Lab Head':24, 'Billing':24, 'Medical Records':24, 'Patient':48 };
    var slaValues = {};
    function renderSLA(){
      if(!slaListEl) return;
      slaListEl.innerHTML = '';
      approvers.forEach(function(a){
        if(slaValues[a.name] === undefined){ slaValues[a.name] = slaDefaults[a.name] || 24; }
        var row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'swfstudio-slarow';
        row.innerHTML =
          '<span class="swfstudio-slaname">'+a.name+'</span>'+
          '<span class="swfstudio-stepper">'+
            '<button type="button" class="swfstudio-stepbtn swfstudio-sla-minus" aria-label="Decrease SLA for '+a.name+'">−</button>'+
            '<span class="swfstudio-slaval">'+slaValues[a.name]+'h</span>'+
            '<button type="button" class="swfstudio-stepbtn swfstudio-sla-plus" aria-label="Increase SLA for '+a.name+'">+</button>'+
          '</span>';
        (function(name, node){
          node.querySelector('.swfstudio-sla-minus').addEventListener('click', function(){
            slaValues[name] = Math.max(2, slaValues[name] - (slaValues[name] > 24 ? 12 : 2));
            node.querySelector('.swfstudio-slaval').textContent = slaValues[name] + 'h';
          });
          node.querySelector('.swfstudio-sla-plus').addEventListener('click', function(){
            slaValues[name] = Math.min(168, slaValues[name] + (slaValues[name] >= 24 ? 12 : 2));
            node.querySelector('.swfstudio-slaval').textContent = slaValues[name] + 'h';
          });
        })(a.name, row);
        slaListEl.appendChild(row);
      });
    }

    // ---------- pick-chip groups (toggle) ----------
    root.querySelectorAll('.swfstudio-pickchip[data-cat], .swfstudio-pickchip[data-lang]').forEach(function(c){
      c.addEventListener('click', function(){
        c.setAttribute('aria-pressed', c.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true' ? 'false' : 'true');
      });
    });
    // validity window — single choice
    root.querySelectorAll('.swfstudio-pickchip[data-win]').forEach(function(c){
      c.addEventListener('click', function(){
        root.querySelectorAll('.swfstudio-pickchip[data-win]').forEach(function(b){ b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false'); });
        c.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');
      });
    });

    // ---------- templates (step 1) ----------
    var draftName = root.querySelector('#swfstudio-draftname');
    root.querySelectorAll('.swfstudio-tpl').forEach(function(t){
      t.addEventListener('click', function(){
        root.querySelectorAll('.swfstudio-tpl').forEach(function(b){ b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false'); });
        t.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');
        var name = t.getAttribute('data-tpl');
        if(draftName) draftName.textContent = 'Draft · ' + name;
      });
    });

    // ---------- evidence / expiry toggles ----------
    root.querySelectorAll('.swfstudio-toggle').forEach(function(t){
      t.addEventListener('click', function(){
        t.setAttribute('aria-checked', t.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true' ? 'false' : 'true');
      });
    });

    // ---------- preview build (step 5) ----------
    function selectedTpl(){
      var el = root.querySelector('.swfstudio-tpl[aria-pressed="true"]');
      return el ? el.getAttribute('data-tpl') : 'Insurance claim share';
    }
    function selectedList(sel){
      var out = [];
      root.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(function(c){ if(c.getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='true'){ out.push(c.textContent.trim()); } });
      return out;
    }
    function buildPreview(){
      // summary text
      root.querySelector('#swfstudio-sum-tpl').textContent = selectedTpl();
      var cats = selectedList('.swfstudio-pickchip[data-cat]');
      root.querySelector('#swfstudio-sum-cat').textContent = cats.length ? cats.join(' · ') : 'None selected';
      var winEl = root.querySelector('.swfstudio-pickchip[data-win][aria-pressed="true"]');
      root.querySelector('#swfstudio-sum-win').textContent = winEl ? winEl.textContent.trim() : '—';
      root.querySelector('#swfstudio-sum-mode').textContent = approverMode === 'parallel' ? 'Parallel (all at once)' : 'Sequential (one after another)';
      var langs = selectedList('.swfstudio-pickchip[data-lang]');
      root.querySelector('#swfstudio-sum-lang').textContent = langs.length ? langs.join(' · ') : 'None';
      var ev = root.querySelector('#swfstudio-tog-evidence');
      root.querySelector('#swfstudio-sum-ev').textContent = (ev && ev.getAttribute('aria-checked')==='true') ? 'On' : 'Off';

      // flow diagram
      var flow = root.querySelector('#swfstudio-flowpreview');
      flow.innerHTML = '';
      var nodes = [{ name:'Patient request', sub:selectedTpl(), icon:'patient' }];
      approvers.forEach(function(a){ nodes.push({ name:a.name, sub:(approverMode==='parallel'?'parallel':slaValues[a.name]+'h SLA'), icon:a.icon }); });
      nodes.push({ name:'Data shared', sub:(winEl?winEl.textContent.trim():'')+' window', icon:'shield' });
      nodes.forEach(function(n, i){
        if(i>0){
          var ar = document.createElement('div');
          ar.className = 'swfstudio-flowarrow';
          ar.innerHTML = '<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 5v14M6 13l6 6 6-6"/></svg>';
          flow.appendChild(ar);
        }
        var node = document.createElement('div');
        node.className = 'swfstudio-flownode';
        node.innerHTML = '<span class="swfstudio-fnico">'+approverIcon(n.icon)+'</span><span><h6>'+n.name+'</h6><span>'+n.sub+'</span></span>';
        flow.appendChild(node);
      });
    }

    // ---------- publish ----------
    if(publishBtn){
      publishBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
        published = true;
        render();
      });
    }

    // ---------- step nav core ----------
    function show(step){
      current = step;
      render();
    }
    function render(){
      // screens
      screens.forEach(function(s){
        s.setAttribute('data-active', (!published && parseInt(s.getAttribute('data-screen'),10) === current) ? 'true' : 'false');
      });
      if(publishedView) publishedView.setAttribute('data-active', published ? 'true' : 'false');

      // build preview when arriving at step 5
      if(current === 5 && !published){ buildPreview(); }

      // rail
      railSteps.forEach(function(r){
        var n = parseInt(r.getAttribute('data-step'),10);
        r.setAttribute('data-on', (!published && n === current) ? 'true' : 'false');
        r.setAttribute('data-done', (published || n < current) ? 'true' : 'false');
      });
      // dots
      dots.forEach(function(d){
        var g = parseInt(d.getAttribute('data-go'),10);
        d.setAttribute('aria-current', (!published && g === current) ? 'true' : 'false');
      });

      // back
      backBtn.disabled = (current === 1 && !published);

      // next / publish-state
      if(published){
        stepInd.textContent = 'Published · v3';
        nextBtn.textContent = 'Restart build';
        nextBtn.disabled = false;
        nextBtn.style.visibility = 'visible';
        nextBtn.innerHTML = '<svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 3-6.7L3 8"/><path d="M3 3v5h5"/></svg> New workflow';
      } else {
        stepInd.textContent = 'Step ' + current + ' of ' + TOTAL;
        if(current === TOTAL){
          nextBtn.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        } else {
          nextBtn.style.visibility = 'visible';
          nextBtn.disabled = false;
          nextBtn.innerHTML = 'Next <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 18l6-6-6-6"/></svg>';
        }
      }
    }

    function goNext(){
      if(published){ restart(); return; }
      if(current < TOTAL){ show(current + 1); }
    }
    function goBack(){
      if(published){ published = false; show(TOTAL); return; }
      if(current > 1){ show(current - 1); }
    }
    function goTo(step){
      if(published) return;
      if(step !== current){ show(step); }
    }
    function restart(){
      published = false;
      current = 1;
      // reset approvers to default
      approvers = [
        { name:'Physician', sub:'Treating doctor confirms the request is clinically valid', icon:'physician' },
        { name:'DPO / Ethics', sub:'Data Protection Officer checks the privacy basis', icon:'shield' },
        { name:'Patient', sub:'Final consent — the patient must approve', icon:'patient', fixed:true }
      ];
      approverMode = 'sequential';
      slaValues = {};
      root.querySelectorAll('.swfstudio-modebtn').forEach(function(b){ b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b.getAttribute('data-mode')==='sequential'?'true':'false'); });
      renderApprovers();
      renderSLA();
      render();
    }

    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', goNext);
    backBtn.addEventListener('click', goBack);
    dots.forEach(function(d){
      d.addEventListener('click', function(){ goTo(parseInt(d.getAttribute('data-go'),10)); });
    });
    restartBtn.addEventListener('click', restart);

    // init
    renderApprovers();
    renderSLA();
    show(1);
  })();
  </script>
